summary: Comprehensive architecture and implementation plan for integrating Google Search data grounding (gemini-3.8-flash), audio transcription (gemini-3.5-transcribe), and a multi-turn Gemini chatbot with 3-tier model routing (gemini-4-argon, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-lite) across the dedicated Tactical Command tab and collapsible drawer.
